pages.title: Dashboard
pages.description: The plan at a glance: the verdict (funded or depleted, with age and shortfall), key metrics, and the doors to everything else.

pages.title: Details
pages.description: Every input behind the plan, sectioned: personal profile, spouse, account balances and contribution room (TFSA/RRSP), contribution rates, income, government benefits, cash events, spending phases, debts and the reverse mortgage, and market hypotheses.

pages.title: Projection
pages.description: The projection: the money-over-age timeline plus the schedule table — one row per retirement year with withdrawals, tax, and balances — pick the columns you care about.

pages.title: Steering
pages.description: The equalizer: drag the plan’s levers (CPP/OAS timing, pension start, withdrawal order, reverse mortgage, part-time work) with the projection timeline under your hands, and see the ranking of what helps most.

pages.title: Optimizer
pages.description: The strategy explorer: named plan variants (CPP/OAS timing, pension start, withdrawal order, reverse mortgage, part-time work) each replayed and scored on sustainable spending, lifetime tax and GIS — with one-click apply.

pages.title: Monte Carlo
pages.description: Probabilistic run: 500 randomized market futures over your plan — the success-rate fan, the odds of lasting, and a depletion histogram.

pages.title: Backtest
pages.description: Run the plan against every historical market stretch on record — real returns, not invented ones — and see how often it would have survived.

pages.title: Solver
pages.description: Invert the verdict: pick a confidence level and the solver binary-searches the most you can spend per year while the Monte Carlo still succeeds that often — then apply it in one click.

pages.title: Profiles
pages.description: Your saved plans: open, rename, duplicate, delete, and roll back revisions — plus the side-by-side comparison of every profile.

pages.title: Data
pages.description: Everything in and out: share a plan by link or code, full backup and restore, and exporting the plan or projections to CSV/JSON.

pages.title: Print & export
pages.description: One-page printable summary of the plan and its key numbers, with the export options.

pages.title: Settings
pages.description: Tax tables (user-editable), export defaults, assistant/system prompt defaults.

pages.title: Assistant connection
pages.description: Where the assistant runs: local model or online provider, the API key, and exactly what the chat may see.

pages.title: Assistant
pages.description: The AI assistant full-screen: ask about the plan, what-if it, or change it with propose_* cards you approve.

pages.title: Help
pages.description: In-app explanation of every feature in the plain-language terms the app itself uses.

pages.title: Support this app
pages.description: Ways to support the app (it is free and open source).

pages.title: Welcome
pages.description: The front door: five questions build a starter plan, then the doors to the rest of the app.
